Geographies Served Programs Creative School District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Creative is a purposeful community and accredited holistic school situated in North Bangalore, catering to children, parents, and educators alike. Rooted in the ethos of sadhana and service, it draws inspiration from the principles of Integral Education espoused by Sri Aurobindo and The Mother, as well as insights from various spiritual mentors and educationalists. Embracing a holistic approach to education, Creative addresses the physical, emotional, intellectual, and spiritual facets of learning, recognizing each child as a complete individual. The curriculum is designed to honor the unique essence of every child, fostering their holistic development. Inclusivity is a core value, as the school welcomes children from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds and with special needs, ensuring that all receive the support they require to thrive. Prajña Wisdom Centre District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka The focus is on empowering both children and teachers to lead enriching lives, nurturing their physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Spirituality is approached with a scientific perspective, fostering an understanding of the interconnectedness of all aspects of existence within the community. Prajña Wisdom Centre serves as a hub for self-transformation, fostering a vibrant community of individuals dedicated to learning and evolving together.
